title: System test: a network server and two full desktop-app stacks enroll, sign in and chat
spec: No new behaviour: an acceptance test over real parts. A server bound with the network path and a configured name, two desktop-app Controllers with their own data folders: each enrolls from an invitation code (authenticator setup URI checked, first code confirmed), signs in with a fresh TOTP code, follows the room, and each sees the other's message. A restart of one app from its data folder goes straight to sign-in.
